T: One client, one goldfish, one big dinner.
D: A sports agent loses everything after writing a mission statement and starts again with one client and one loyal colleague.
P: Serve the mains when Rod finally gets his big night on the Monday night game.
S: Laurel's caramelised onion dip with chips
Slow-cooked onion, sour cream and cream cheese dip with kettle chips

Onions cooked down slowly until jammy and dark, folded into sour cream and cream cheese with chives, served with salted kettle chips and celery. Slowly cook 3 thinly sliced onions in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil over low heat for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until deep brown. Add 1 tsp balsamic and cool. Chop roughly and mix with 250g sour cream, 100g soft cream cheese, 1 tsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp chives, salt and pepper. Chill 1 hour. Serve with 200g salted kettle chips and celery sticks.
Show me the money street corn
Grilled corn with mayo, crumbled feta and chilli

Grilled corn cobs brushed with mayo, rolled in crumbly cheese and chilli, with a squeeze of lime. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning, until charred in spots. Brush each with mayonnaise (4 tbsp total), roll in 80g crumbled feta and dust with chilli powder. Squeeze over lime to serve.
Monday night chorizo pigs in blankets
Rod's big Monday Night Football game

Mini chorizo wrapped in flaky puff pastry with a smear of chipotle mayo, baked golden and served with a honey mustard for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 thawed puff pastry sheets into 3cm by 8cm strips. Mix 2 tbsp mayo with 1 tsp chipotle in adobo and spread a little on each strip. Cut 4 chorizo into 6 pieces each and roll each piece in a strip, seam side down. Brush with egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon with 2 tbsp honey for dipping.
M: Lime and orange marinated skirt steak with warm tortillas and salsa
Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and orange, grilled hot and sliced, with tortillas, salsa and beans.
a family dinner with plenty of kwan

Shredded chicken rolled in corn tortillas, smothered in a smoky chilli and dark chocolate mole sauce and cheese, baked bubbling, with pickled onion and crema. Soak 3 dried ancho chillies in boiling water 15 minutes. Blend with 400g tinned tomatoes, 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, half a tsp cinnamon, 30g dark chocolate and 300ml stock, then simmer 15 minutes. Mix 600g shredded roast chicken with a third of the sauce. Fill and roll 8 corn tortillas, lay in a dish, cover with the rest of the sauce and 150g grated cheese. Bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Top with pickled red onion, sour cream and coriander.
W: Had me at hello wedding cupcakes

Light vanilla cupcakes topped with swirls of white buttercream and a sugared flower, stacked up like a small wedding cake. Beat 125g butter with 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla, then fold in 150g self-raising flour and 60ml milk. Bake in 12 cases at 175C for 18 minutes. Beat 125g butter with 250g icing sugar and pipe on top.
K: Tequila, prickly pear, lime and agave with a chilli salt rim

Tequila shaken with prickly pear purée, fresh lime and agave until bright magenta, poured over ice in glasses rimmed with chilli salt. Peel 6 prickly pears (or use 200ml prickly pear purée), blend and strain out the seeds. Mix 1 tbsp salt with half a tsp chilli powder, wet the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip. For each drink, shake 45ml tequila, 50ml purée, 30ml lime juice and 15ml agave syrup hard with ice. Strain over fresh ice. For non-drinkers, skip the tequila and top with soda water.
